summary: Check the clause missing from the supplied corpus Turoyo
rationale: The glossary includes this clause about letting his mare tire, but the supplied Turoyo at 29/167 jumps directly from dlo təʕbo to gšəqli i fərṣa mene. Its German translation nevertheless includes und laß seine Stute müde werden. The citation is correct; the corpus transcription may have omitted the clause. Check the edition before changing the glossary.
